verdict.rationale: Segment supports warehouse/lake delivery via Data Storage Destinations (Snowflake, BigQuery, S3, etc.) and Reverse ETL for syncing back from warehouses, but these are destination-style syncs configured within Segment rather than a fully self-controlled, schedule-driven pipeline the data engineer independently manages. missing for 10: explicit ClickHouse support, details on sync scheduling/frequency control, and independent/hands-on confirmation that raw event and profile data lands reliably in the warehouse on a customer-defined schedule.
